sectionsIncluded.note: FLAGGED FOR REVIEW, NOT DECIDED: found by review of #2388 (SMLB-1..30, staged there, are the Series 1 half of this SAME product). #2388's own S1 ladder reads verbatim 'Gold Foilboard /50; Orange Foilboard /25; Black Foilboard /10; Red Foilboard /5; FoilFractor 1/1' -- this Series 2 continuation states 'Foil' where Series 1 states 'Foilboard' for the identical colour/print-run combination (Gold/50, Orange/25, Black/10, Red/5). Same rung or a genuinely distinct one? Not decided here -- staged EXACTLY as the Series 2 page states it (Foil, not Foilboard), because the two halves cover disjoint cardNumbers (#1-30 vs #31-60, zero overlap, confirmed) so there is no collision either way and no technical reason to pick one spelling over the other. computeHobbyIqCardId slugs them differently (gold-foilboard vs gold-foil) -- verified directly. Needs Drew's call on whether Series 2's rung name should be aligned to Series 1's or left as its own distinct rung name.

rrr.reason: RRR- was named in the original sold_comps sample under bare 'topps', but no RRR- roster exists anywhere on either the 2025 Topps Series 1 or Series 2 checklistinsider pages (searched both, case-insensitive, zero hits). Catalog already carries RRR- rows under the CORRECT sibling key topps-update-series (confirmed present in the original diagnosis, e.g. hiq:baseball:2025:topps-update-series:rrr-hb:orange). The topps-prefixed RRR- sales are very likely a wrong-key/sale-side classification issue (RRR belongs to Update Series, not Series 1/2), not a checklist gap -- not staged, flagged for engineering.

raInChromeUpdateAutographs.reason: See acq-2026-09-21-checklistinsider-topps-chrome-2025-inserts's own manifest: the 'Chrome Update Autographs' 127-card set splits into AC- (110, staged there) + a 17-card RA- continuation with no section boundary. RA- is out of this diagnosis's target prefix list (nt-, cla-, ac-, crda-, chru-) and was not independently roster-verified -- not staged.

isAutoConsistencyCheck: Every row for a given cardNumber prefix carries the SAME isAuto value (WCDA-/FPA-/90CAS-/90A-/90AU- all true; MLMD2-/90ASR- all false) -- verified by tallying the isAuto distribution per prefix before staging (0 mixed-prefix rows).
additiveOnlyCheck: fpa_s1 (9 codes) and 90au (201 codes) already had their blank-parallel base row staged in acq-2026-09-20-beckett-topps-series1-2025-baseball's own CSV -- discovered because computeHobbyIqCardId does NOT read the CSV's `category` column at all (verified directly in ingest-checklist-csv-to-catalog.cjs: only sport/year/setKey/cardNumber/parallel/isAuto/printRun feed the id), so a blank-parallel row under my own category name (auto-first-pitch-autographs / auto-1990-topps-autographs) collides on id with the base package's row filed under a DIFFERENT category label (auto-2024-first-pitch-autographs / auto-1990-topps-baseball-autographs) for the exact same card. Both base rows skipped in this package; only their missing colour rungs are added.
